overview_description.description: Zuma AI is transforming multifamily operations with Kelsey, an agentic AI for your full resident lifecycle. Built for property managers and multifamily operators, Kelsey automates leasing, rent collections, voice AI workflows, and more. Leveraging a human-in-the-loop model, Kelsey captures leads, books tours, follows up with prospects, and supports residents in real time, 24/7/365. By eliminating busywork, Zuma empowers onsite teams to focus on hospitality, relationships, and community while helping operators boost occupancy, NOI, and resident satisfaction.

about_short_description.short_description: Agentic AI for multifamily property management companies

product.name: Zuma AI Assistant Platform (Kelsey)
product.description: An agentic AI platform for multifamily property managers that supports leasing, rent collections, move-outs, and resident communications across phone, text, email, and webchat.

product.name: Leasing AI
product.description: An AI leasing assistant that responds to prospect inquiries, qualifies leads, schedules tours, and manages follow-up through integrated CRM and property management systems.

product.name: Collections AI
product.description: An AI rent-collection service that sends payment reminders, follows up with delinquent residents, tracks promise-to-pay dates, and provides collection workflow visibility.

product.name: VoiceAI
product.description: A customizable AI receptionist for multifamily properties that answers and manages property-related calls, provides information, and supports lead and resident workflows.

product.name: Move-out Workflow Automation
product.description: An AI-supported move-out service that manages notices, final inspections, balance reconciliation, and security-deposit return tracking for multifamily properties.
